boundaries: No frontend Undo/Ctrl+Z/client lifecycle implementation, no Redo/history UI. Metadata frontend flag and private Undo protocol both remain default off.
Existing Patch result and function definitions preserved, including undo_supported:false; a future opt-in client must use the new protocol reader deliberately.

Legacy operations lack trustworthy origin-tab context: conservatively clear this actor/trip pointers in all tabs, not only current tab. This differs from the final B-1 target and must be resolved before activation.

Noncanonical/invalid legacy before-images (ordinary spaces, empty note strings or empty required title) are not exactly restorable through the canonical Patch; exclude them and clear actor/trip pointers instead of inventing an inverse.
Actual linkage/origin, parent financial edits, child/receipt/rate/date changes fence affected metadata lineage even if values later return.
No hosted migrations/data/deploy/main merge. No payment/pricing/category/blank creation inverse or financial redesign.
